action.estimate_note: This is an estimate. Your minimum is the condition that matters.

review.minimum_changed: You lowered your minimum. Please check the new amount before signing.
review.expiry_note: This action must finish before either limit is reached.
review.expired: This review has expired. Check the numbers again for a fresh one.
review.stale: The numbers have moved. Let us take another look.
review.missing: We could not find this review. Start with a fresh action.
review.share_note: Anyone with this link can see the amounts and conditions in this review. Only your wallet can approve the action.
review.failure_fee: If the submitted action fails, its asset changes are rolled back. A network fee may still apply.

route.unsupported: This vault is not supported yet. Choose a supported vault to continue.

pending.leave: You can leave this page. Your transaction hash will be here when you return.
pending.storage_unavailable: This browser cannot save your action here. Keep this link so you can check the result later.

failure.authority: The wallet authorization did not match this action. Start with a fresh review.

activity.empty: Nothing here yet. A perfectly respectable start.
receipt.heading: Your receipt
receipt.unresolved: This transaction result has not been confirmed by the available provider.

input.positive: Choose an amount greater than zero.
input.too_large: That amount is too large for this action.
error.summary: A few details need your attention
service.unavailable: We cannot check the network right now. Your draft is still here.
service.offline: You appear to be offline. Reconnect to check this action.
service.busy: The network check is busy. Give it a moment, then try again.
help.guarantee: For supported actions, Mierkhat checks the shares spent and the minimum tokens received before the action can complete.
help.limits: These conditions apply to this action. They do not guarantee future token value or prevent an issuer from freezing an asset later.
app.tagline: A little certainty for your next move.
app.vault_empty: No reviewed vaults are available yet.
app.shares_note: Only the shares you choose can be spent.
app.outcome_note: Your existing asset balances stay where they are.
app.freshness_empty: Check an action to see its current estimate.
app.activity_note: Your next move gets a paper trail.
app.supported_body: Vault redemption and direct conversions, together in one action.
app.not_connected: Connect a wallet to check your available shares.
app.help_intro: Your minimum is a condition of the whole action. If the action cannot meet it, its asset changes do not commit.
app.help_fee: What a failed action can cost
app.help_fee_body: A confirmed failed transaction can still consume its network fee and account sequence. An unknown result needs checking before another attempt.
app.help_wallet_body: Mierkhat never asks for a seed phrase. Your wallet signs the exact action after you review it.
app.details_empty: There is no enabled deployment. Contract identities appear here after a deployment is reviewed.
app.pending_hold: Check the tracked action before preparing another.
app.storage_continue: I saved the action link. Submit now.
app.storage_before_send: Save the action link before submitting. This browser cannot retain your pending action.
app.invalid_hash: This transaction link does not contain a valid hash.
app.review_other_owner: Connect the account named in this review to continue.
app.minimum_confirm: I have checked the lower minimum.
app.not_found: This page is not here. Your action is a good place to start.
app.signing_cancelled: This wallet prompt has been left. Its response will be ignored.
app.mainnet_unavailable: Mainnet is not available in this release.
app.embed_unavailable: We could not check this action.
app.link_saved: Keep the action link before continuing.
app.minimum_note: This is the exact least amount you approve.
home.intro: Turn vault shares into the token you want. Set what you spend and the least you receive. Mierkhat makes those conditions part of the transaction.
home.route_note: Real vault assets. Direct routes. A result your wallet can verify.
home.live_note: Read directly from Stellar. Values refresh as ledgers close.
home.promise_intro: A quote can move. Your signed conditions stay put. Each part of the exit has to fit before its asset changes can commit.
home.condition_spend: Spend exactly the shares you choose
home.condition_spend_body: Your signature binds the share amount. The guard checks the actual amount spent before completing.
home.condition_receive: Receive at least your chosen minimum
home.condition_receive_body: The guard measures the settlement tokens returned to your account. Falling short rolls back the action.
home.condition_balance_body: Only assets withdrawn by this action fund its conversions. Existing underlying balances remain unchanged.
home.condition_expiry: Put a time limit on the whole action
home.condition_expiry_body: Time and ledger bounds expire together with your intent. An old signature cannot quietly become a new trade.
home.start_body: Connect Freighter, fund a testnet account, deposit into the vault and make a guarded exit. Every balance and receipt comes from the network.
home.testnet_note: Testnet assets have no monetary value. This deployment uses verified pinned contracts. Independent security review and mainnet release remain separate gates.
workspace.heading: Make your move.
workspace.intro: Your wallet. Your amounts. Your final say.
workspace.connect_body: Connect Freighter on Stellar testnet to read your balances and build a real transaction.
workspace.action_note: Deposits supply the vault. Guarded exits redeem your shares and convert the proceeds into the settlement token.
setup.heading: Get your wallet ready
setup.body: Use real Stellar testnet assets for the complete flow. Your wallet signs trustlines and deposits.
setup.faucet_note: The faucet issues 1000 of each vault asset and settlement token per account every 24 hours. These are actual testnet balances.
setup.trust_required: Approve the token trustlines before receiving testnet assets.
setup.trust_body: This transaction creates trustlines for the exact issuer and tokens shown below. It does not send tokens.
funding.unavailable: Friendbot could not fund this account. Give it a moment and try again.
faucet.unavailable: The token faucet is not configured on this service.
faucet.busy: Another grant is being confirmed. Try again in a moment.
faucet.limit: The faucet has reached its daily limit. Existing tokens can still be used.
deposit.heading: Put your assets to work.
deposit.intro: Choose how much of each vault asset to supply. Your wallet approves only this deposit.
deposit.note: The vault accepts assets in its current ratio. Unused tokens stay in your wallet. Your signed limits bound each asset transfer.
deposit.rejected: The vault cannot accept these amounts. Check your balances and the asset ratio.
deposit.ratio: The vault currently holds equal amounts of both assets.
deposit.shares_note: Share issuance follows the pinned vault contract. The deposit does not contain a minimum share condition.
exit.heading: Leave on your terms.
exit.intro: Choose your shares. Get a live route quote. Set the amount the whole action must return.
exit.minimum_note: Your minimum and each route limit are calculated from this live quote. You can raise the final minimum before reviewing.
exit.quote_expired: Get a fresh quote before reviewing.
exit.empty: Your route appears here after a live quote.
exit.balance: That amount exceeds your current balance.
exit.no_shares: Deposit assets to receive vault shares before making an exit.
exit.high_minimum: The live route does not meet this minimum. Raise the available output or choose a lower minimum.
activity.lookup_note: Paste a Stellar testnet transaction hash to check its actual network result.
receipt.submission_unknown: Submission was not acknowledged. Keep this hash and check the result before creating another transaction.
receipt.no_guard: This is a confirmed transaction. A Mierkhat exit receipt is shown only when its guard result can be verified.
receipt.resume_note: The service retains exact signed bytes for recovery. A new signature is not required to track this hash.
review.confirm: I have checked the amounts and conditions.
contracts.heading: See what your action calls.
contracts.body: The browser and guard check fixed contract identities and executable hashes. These addresses are the actual deployed Stellar testnet contracts.
contracts.review_note: Source and integration checks are complete for this testnet profile. An independent security audit has not been completed.
help.title: Know what happens next.
help.pending: What if the result is unknown?
help.pending_body: Keep the transaction hash. The service checks the ledger before resending the exact signed bytes. Unknown means unconfirmed, so do not create a duplicate action.
help.testnet_body: Yes. Funding, trustlines, token issuance, deposits and exits use Stellar testnet. Assets have no monetary value, but signatures, state changes and fees are real testnet operations.
help.preflight: Why does my wallet mention simulation?
help.preflight_body: Soroban wallets and RPC nodes preflight a contract call to calculate resources and fees. The app still submits the signed transaction, and only committed ledger results produce a confirmed receipt.
error.wallet_install: Install or unlock Freighter, select Stellar testnet, then connect again.
app.no_deployment: The testnet deployment is currently unavailable.
input.hash_required: Enter a 64 character hexadecimal transaction hash.
